label: MCS-8M example
info:
Minimal example for the Sony MCS-8M RS-232 protocol.
Needs node-red-node-serialport. Set your serial port in the 'MCS-8M port' config node.
See https://github.com/ispyisail/mcs8m-protocol

name: Video replies take ~1 s: the delay node spaces requests 1.2 s apart. Panel changes arrive on their own.
